Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE: 8u461, 8u461-perf, 11.0.28, 17.0.16, 21.0.8, 25; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.16 and 21.0.8; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.15.
statements.impact_statement: Oracle Java SE JAXP vulnerability. The advisory fixes Oracle Java SE 21.0.9, while the scanner reported 21.0.8+9-LTS for this image. Liquibase Secure is built from eclipse-temurin:21-jre-noble (docker/Dockerfile:2) and runs the CLI through docker/Dockerfile:68, not an Oracle Java SE or GraalVM client runtime. The Oracle client environment required by the advisory is absent in this deployment.

statements.status_notes: Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE (component: AWT, JavaFX). Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE: 8u471, 8u471-b50, 8u471-perf, 11.0.29, 17.0.17, 21.0.9, 25.0.1; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.17 and 21.0.9; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.16. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. Successful attacks require human interaction from a person other than the attacker and while the vulnerability is in Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition, attacks may significantly impact additional products (scope change). Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to critical data or all Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition accessible data.
statements.impact_statement: Oracle Java SE AWT/JavaFX sandbox vulnerability. Liquibase Secure is built from eclipse-temurin:21-jre-noble (core/docker/Dockerfile:1), not an Oracle Java SE or GraalVM client distribution. The container runs the Liquibase CLI through docker-entrypoint.sh rather than a sandboxed Java Web Start or applet environment (core/docker/docker-entrypoint.sh:8), so the client-only runtime required by the advisory is absent.

statements.status_notes: Little CMS (lcms2) through 2.18 has an integer overflow in CubeSize in cmslut.c because the overflow check is performed after the multiplication.
statements.impact_statement: Little CMS 2.18 integer overflow in CubeSize/cmslut.c. The scan reported Oracle OpenJDK 21.0.11+10-LTS, but Liquibase Secure is built from eclipse-temurin:21-jre-noble (core/docker/Dockerfile:1) and contains no Little CMS/lcms2 references in the repository, so the scanner's openjdk match is a false product match.
